metadata.description: Skills that make an AI agent report what it cannot do. root-cause forbids a causal claim without evidence and recurses to a structural cause. sitrep forces the finding into the first sentence, bad news above good news, stated confidence, and a named gap for anything unverified. Ships clarity.py, which scores a draft against the standard so the rule is a check rather than advice.

plugins.name: honest-skills
plugins.description: Evidence discipline for AI agents: no unproven causal claims, no buried bad news, no unstated confidence.
